description: Restyle the Nav component and DemoBanner to follow the style guide. Nav currently has 11 links (exceeds max 5 rule). Since this is a professional tool with many sections, implement a grouped nav: show 5 primary links visible, with remaining items accessible via a 'More' disclosure. Nav must not stick, use ink underline for current page, no dropdowns/mega menu. DemoBanner uses quiet ink styling.
steps: Restyle src/components/Nav.tsx: Remove bg-white border-b border-gray-200 card styling. Apply bg-paper with a 1px border-b border-rule bottom edge. Use max-w-[720px] (the style guide's single-column width) centered with 24px side padding. Title uses text-h1 weight 300 in ink. Subtitle uses text-body in ink-50. Nav links: show first 5 (Jobs, Tracker, Experience, Resume, Profile) as visible inline links in text-body ink, with current page getting a 2px border-b border-ink underline. Group remaining 6 links (Skills, Phrases, Companies, Claims, Documents, Eval) behind a disclosure button labeled 'More' that expands a simple ruled list below. All touch targets minimum 44px. No hover color changes on links (just underline on active). Remove font-medium blue styling. Use sentence case.

Restyle src/components/DemoBanner.tsx: Remove bg-amber-100 border-amber-300 yellow styling. Apply border-b border-rule with text-meta font-mono uppercase tracking-wider in ink-50. No background fill (bg-paper). Remove font-medium. Ensure min-height 44px for touch target. No exclamation marks in the text.
acceptance_criteria: Nav shows max 5 primary links visible at top level
Additional links accessible via More disclosure
Nav has border-b border-rule, no background fill other than paper
Active page would have ink underline (prepared via className pattern)
All nav targets at least 44px tall
DemoBanner uses mono meta style with rule border, no color fill
findings: Nav converted from server component to client component (use client) to enable usePathname for current page detection. More disclosure uses useState toggle with absolute-positioned ruled list. Build passes cleanly. The component now uses Tailwind v4 theme tokens (border-rule, bg-paper, text-ink, text-ink-50, text-body, text-h1, px-s-3, py-s-3, gap-s-3, etc.) and the --target-min CSS custom property for 44px min heights.
